articles.title: Republic Day parade blends Vande Mataram tribute with display of India’s unmanned military systems
articles.summary: At the 77th Republic Day parade, India magnificently showcased its rich cultural heritage, celebrating 150 years of the national song Vande Mataram. The parade also highlighted India's growing military prowess, prominently featuring a diverse range of advanced unmanned systems. This display underscored the nation's commitment to modern defence capabilities and national pride, reflecting both tradition and future readiness.
